messages:
Priya: heads-up 15% of inbound HubSpot leads failed to be claimed within 15m over the past 12h, skewed to EU/APAC. seeing enrichment timeouts and occasional webhook 5xx. tagging @Mateo @Lin for triage.
Mateo: thanks. any sample lead_ids? is this only round-robin or also direct-assign flows?
Priya: sample: 900112,900118,900129. mostly RR; direct-assign seems ok. link to filter: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/filter/unclaimed-15m
Lin: grabbed logs. enrichment peak at 2024-07-02T18:04Z with p95 enrichment_ms ~ 4.2s and a retry storm from webhook retries. RR ack_window currently 15s which is too low given retries + SF provisioning latency.
Jordan: business note VIP leads are in that bucket (we classify by lead_score>90). urgency: we can't lose those. Recommend VIPs bypass RR or use immediate fallback owner.
OpsBot: webhook-monitor: 502 spikes 2024-07-02T18:02:31 - 18:10:12 (34 events). ref: ops/logs/webhooks/2024-07-02
Priya: suggested short-term rollout plan:
- bump ack_window to 90s for EU/APAC connectors (canary 5% traffic for 30m)
- enable prewarm_enrichment=true for connectors with external enrichment calls
- add HS fallback rule: after 10m unclaimed -> owner set to "email-team-fallback"
- VIP bypass: route lead to high-priority queue immediately
- add Slack alert to #sales when any VIP unclaimed at 5m
Mateo: agree. will open a lightweight service PR and add a canary flag. also proposing a metric and pager: pct_unclaimed_15m > 5% -> page oncall.
Lin: DB diagnostic to run (BQ):
```
SELECT lead_id, created_at, region, enrichment_ms, rr_slot_acquired_ms, claimed_at
FROM `prod.marketing.inbound_leads`
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND claimed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
This will show acq vs ack gaps.
Jordan: i'll update the HS workflow to add the fallback owner mapping and create the VIP rule. i'll coordinate SF mapping to avoid duplicate owner churn.
Priya: owners: Mateo (service PR + canary), Lin (diagnostics + metrics), Jordan (HS workflow + SF mapping), Mateo+Jordan (VIP bypass approval). i'll create a 20m sync after the canary starts.
Mateo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/leadrouter/pull/499 canary 5% start ts 1722223360. will post rollup metrics to this thread.
Priya: add rollback criteria: increase in pct_unclaimed_15m or new 5xx > baseline. flagged for review in morning post-metrics. thanks team. :rocket:
